extension.description: View and edit CSV and TSV files as tables in VS Code.
configuration.title: CSV Table Editor
configuration.cellMaxCell.description: Maximum automatic column width in pixels, based on the first 100 data rows when a file is opened. Manually resized columns keep their saved widths. Reopen the file to apply changes to automatic widths.
configuration.tableHeader.description: Use the first record as the table header. When disabled, the first record appears as a data row and columns use generated names such as Column 1. Changes apply immediately to open tables.
configuration.showRowNumbers.description: Show the source line number column on the left of the table. Changes apply immediately to open tables.
command.moveCellSelection: CSV Table Editor: Move Cell Selection
command.moveColumnLeft: CSV Table Editor: Move Column Left
command.moveColumnRight: CSV Table Editor: Move Column Right
command.submitCellEdit: CSV Table Editor: Submit Cell Edit
